utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. I can swing by later if you still need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, I can stop by after I finish my errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the repair drive by tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll be ready tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, as far as I know it’s still on today, but I’m a little worried about the timing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, I just wanted to make sure it wasn’t postponed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I might’ve mixed up the time, but I’m here to help and can lend a hand wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. We can use the extra hands at the west side table.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, I’m heading to the west side table now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs to be repaired on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think the main thing was the cracked section near the middle of the drive, and maybe the loose edge by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it - so the cracked section near the middle and the loose edge by the gate are the parts to fix, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late, but I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane. We still need someone to sort the tool table and another pair for the pickup run; can you take one of those?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the tool table, and I’ll get it sorted right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring over my wrench if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know if I need it when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive. Where’s it being dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, at the school office. I can drop the details there before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll note the school office.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands on the repair drive. If you’ve got a free hour, I’d say swing by and ask where they need help most.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m heading over now, Tess — if they need extra hands, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Quinn. I’m heading over too, and I’ll point you to whoever’s organizing the work once I spot them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are you starting the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m starting at 9 this morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time do you think you’ll finish?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check on the repair drive and let Nell know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’ve got the repair drive list ready. Tell me what’s broken, and I’ll make sure we slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive is moving along — folks are dropping things off all afternoon. Eli, I heard they still need a few more hands at the hall if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can spare a little time. Tell me when you need me at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, swing by the hall around five if you can — they’ll put you to work right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, I’m here now. What’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just the last bits now: we’ve got to check the patch kit and then haul the remaining parts over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll check the patch kit and start hauling the rest over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I need help with the front brake. It’s been grinding for a while.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like the brake pads might be worn down. I can take a look and help you figure out what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, can you tell me which house or garage you want me to check?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Which house or garage should I check?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that — what part of the repair drive do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I need you to handle the wiring and the front brake, but please check the parts list first so we don't miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll check the parts list first, then handle the wiring and front brake.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I saw something about it, but I might've missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think the latest update said the drive is still on for Saturday, with tool drop-off at the community center after noon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Saturday after noon at the community center. I should be able to make that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. Need a hand with anything when I get back?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can lend a hand when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll bring the tools when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the wiring and the back door latch. I can bring the list over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, bring the list over and I’ll take a look at the wiring and latch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m worried the timing and materials might get messy, so can we make sure the schedule and supply list are locked down first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, let’s lock both down before anything else. What’s the schedule and who’s handling materials?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me, but I want the schedule in writing and a named person for materials before we start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about it now, Cleo. Come by and I’ll point you to the list and the next pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll come by for the list and pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, see you then, Cleo. I’ll have the list and pickup time ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check my schedule and see when I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye. Just let me know what works for you, and I’ll put it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can see if I can come by after school one day next week, and I’ll confirm as soon as I check with my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll keep the list moving and check in on the repair drive details after this.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll wait for your update and follow along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll send you the update as soon as I’ve checked the repair drive details.
